status: Complete: release build, CPU check, CUDA checks with and without optional cuTile, formatting/whitespace checks and95 distinct tests passed. Current24-request same-GGUF run and both fresh24-request llama controls completed. Uniform10% decode target achieved versus the best historical/fresh control at every length. Final source and release binary exactly match measured provenance.
extended_gpu_test: gguf::fast_mmvq::shared_tests capability fallback test now checks mixed pairs in both operand orders and guards both methods
production_scope: Single-token CUDA paired projections: one supported GGUF matrix and one dense forward-layout matrix; BF16/F16/F32. Both operand orders are supported. Bias, statistics capture, active LoRA, nontrivial collective, odd quantized row count, incompatible vector alignment, unsupported geometry and existing standalone-prefetch cases retain established paths. No permanent duplicate weights or model-specific caller changes.
kernel_reuse: Existing GEMV row arithmetic and GGUF vector-dot arithmetic are shared. One dense-first grid executes compatible projections. Prefetch applies only within eligible mixed pairs.
new_capability: QuantMethod::unquant_forward_weight opts in forward-order storage separately from canonical unquant_weight_bias. UnquantLinear and RuntimeOutput/distributed/Pending/DynamicLoRA wrappers preserve this distinction; nontrivial collectives decline.
review: Independent review caught canonical-versus-forward row order before compilation. An explicit forward-weight capability and a nonidentity-layout regression test resolve it. Final ordinary and prefetch kernel review found no further concrete issue.

prefetch_policy.tradeoff: Some cached paths are slower than plain mixed fusion; all selected measurements still beat original separate projections. Rotating weights improve at the intended long-row shapes.

production_tests: All ten formats and three dtypes, ordinary and geometry-derived prefetch-selected shapes, changed graph inputs, reversed operand order, scratch reuse, odd-tail and layout fallbacks, secondary-stream allocations, and nonidentity packed output order.

associated_changes.dense_source_packing: Common packed-projection factories may pack compatible F32/F16/BF16 GGUF source bindings through an explicit capability. Existing source transform, sharding, cache tracking and constituent-statistics paths remain available.
associated_changes.gemv_alignment: Small GEMV eligibility checks vector2 input/weight alignment on the compute stream; unsupported views use the original matmul.
associated_changes.gemv_statistics: UnquantLinear records activation statistics before the GEMV early return, exactly once per forward.
